about.title:
The technical detail.
The bigger picture.
about.lead: I'm Ruslan. I develop, test and ask questions until the implementation fits the requirement.
paragraphs: I have worked with software quality and SAP business processes since 2017. My path has taken me from test automation and process analysis to Fiori/UI5 development and technical integration.
Today I bring these perspectives together: understanding how an application is used, where reliability matters and how it can evolve in a useful way.
